_leyenda: IMG-54: reglas de la plantilla por capas en un solo sitio. Las leen scripts/capas.py y backend/src/services/imagePromptCapas.ts. Explicación en docs/producto/plan-imagenes/receta-calidad.md (Plantilla por capas).

FOTO.fauna: a wildlife photograph of a real animal taken with a long lens
FOTO.flora: a close-up nature photograph of a real plant taken with a macro lens
FOTO.raza: a film still shot on Kodak Vision3 film with a 35mm lens, natural grain, a real actor in realistic prosthetic makeup on location
FOTO.npc: a film still shot on Kodak Vision3 film with a 35mm lens, natural grain, a real actor in realistic prosthetic makeup on location
FOTO.item: a photograph of a real handmade object, shot on film with a macro lens, natural grain
FOTO.construccion: a film still of a real building on location, shot on 35mm film, natural grain
FOTO.location: a landscape photograph shot on large-format film, natural grain

CLAVE: Low-key exposure, as in a cinema still: deep natural shadows and dark corners, bright only where that light falls.

VETADAS.motivo: engorda la figura («no son gordos, son corpulentos»)
VETADAS.alternativa: as wide as two men, all muscle and heavy bone

VETADAS.motivo: nombrar el vientre pinta abdominales de superhéroe
VETADAS.alternativa: armour that covers chest, stomach and arms, no skin below the neck
massive square towers with flat battlemented tops; o «No spires…» como negación
only a few narrow slit windows, no glass

VETADAS.motivo: oscurece tanto que se pierde el fondo
VETADAS.alternativa: most of the frame in shadow, only the edges lit

VETADAS.motivo: el estilo del boceto pasa a la foto: sale dibujo
el ancla de otra criatura arrastra su aspecto (orejas de elfo, dibujo, piedra)
VETADAS.alternativa: a huge humanoid / a tusked warrior y los rasgos uno a uno con su parecido real

VETADAS.motivo: satura el color (amarillo plástico, lila pastel)
VETADAS.alternativa: dirty off-white, stained brown in its grooves / dull metallic grey

VETADAS.motivo: sobre algo claro se pinta como sangre

VETADAS.alternativa: like a dry-stone wall from irregular rough fieldstones of every size
huge irregular blocks of rough stone, each as tall as a man, fitted like a megalithic wall
short, thick, straight tusks pointing straight up like blunt pegs
sags in a wide open curve
